label: rem:gs-quotient-ideals-i8-i9-remark
title: Why the quotient ideals $I_8$ and $I_9$ reduce the normal form
html: The raw Gröbner--Shirshov normal form (shell closure normal form) contains up to A! terms. The quotient ideals I_8 and I_9 reduce this complexity by absorbing structurally-determined reduced words into the per-generator transfer-matrix factorisation. Under I_8, the coefficient of \sigma_i \sigma_{i+1} is structurally determined by the off-diagonal entry of the transfer matrix product M_i, rather than being independent. Under I_9, the absorption implements the per-generator transfer matrix factorization by replacing the expanded Hecke element with the product of \hat{V}_i volumes.
